تشانأت (form VI)
# تَشَانَأْتُ (tašānaʔtu) /ta.ʃaː.naʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
# تَشَانَأْتَ (tašānaʔta) /ta.ʃaː.naʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
# تَشَانَأْتِ (tašānaʔti) /ta.ʃaː.naʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
# تَشَانَأَتْ (tašānaʔat) /ta.ʃaː.na.ʔat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
